title: Window Contract Credit Rates: Opening Removal, Door Bundle and Referral

# Window Contract Credit Rates: Opening Removal, Door Bundle and Referral

Billing credit schedule for Window Replacement Contracts, by Ridgeline series.

| Series | Opening removal credit (share of the base price per opening) | Door bundle discount (share of the contract price) | Door bundle window (calendar days between signings) | Referral credit per referred household | Most referral credits per contract |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline 1100 Series Vinyl | 100% | 3% | 60 | $100.00 | 3 |
| Ridgeline 2200 Series Vinyl | 100% | 4% | 60 | $100.00 | 3 |
| Ridgeline 3300 Series Premium Vinyl | 100% | 5% | 60 | $150.00 | 3 |
| Ridgeline 4400 Series Composite | 100% | 5% | 60 | $150.00 | 3 |
| Ridgeline 5500 Series Fiberglass | 100% | 6% | 60 | $200.00 | 3 |
| Ridgeline 6600 Series Wood-Clad | 100% | 7% | 60 | $250.00 | 3 |

## Reading the schedule

- A removal share of 100% (1.0) credits the full series base price per opening for each opening removed.
- The door bundle percentage is the series bundle percentage; the bundle window is the most calendar days that may separate the signing dates of the window contract and the door contract.
- The referral figures are a dollar credit per referred household and a count cap per contract.
